title: React Counter Component
description: Create a Counter component with increment and reset functionality. This exercise will help you practice React state management using hooks.
requirements: Use React.useState hook to manage a count state (starting at 0)
Display the current count value in a paragraph element
Create an 'Increment' button that increases the count by 1 when clicked
Create a 'Reset' button that sets the count back to 0 when clicked
Export the Counter component as the default export

browserTests.name: Component renders with initial count of 0
Reset button sets count back to 0

hints: Import useState from 'react' at the top of the file
Call useState(0) to create state: const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
Use {count} in JSX to display the current value
Use onClick prop with arrow functions: onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}
For reset, you can use: onClick={() => setCount(0)}
